issue.body:
`Test e2e self-host` concluded **failure** on a push to main.

- Commit: 3a824efbaf95d3d7191c96a0050ea6d7d8a84944
- Run: https://github.com/JakeChampion/lang/actions/runs/42788315087
- Failing jobs: `Validate / Full suite / Test e2e self-host / test-e2e-selfhost-x86_64-shard2`, `Validate / Full suite / Test e2e self-host / test-e2e-selfhost-x86_64-shard7`, `Validate / Full suite / Test e2e self-host / test-e2e-selfhost-aarch64-shard0`, `Validate / Full suite / Test e2e self-host / test-e2e-selfhost-x86_64-shard9`, `Validate / Full suite / Test e2e self-host / verify`

cancel-on-failure.yml deliberately spares main, so this lane ran to completion and the failing-job list above is the whole set for it, not just the first.

This issue closes itself when `Test e2e self-host` next passes on main, or on the run of the merged pull request whose tree main skipped re-testing.

**Claim this issue before you fix the lane:** assign yourself, or comment `claimed by` and the name of your branch. Look for a claim first, so two sessions do not fix the same lane.

Compiler ownership, feature, complexity, grammar, source, and format checks pass. The separate random-bytes check is still in flight.

comments.body:
One more E009 case, for the claim of `ccr-48f1fb47-ct370r`. Your list does not name it.

`TestSelfHostSemanticSourceRC` (`internal/testing/e2ecompiler/self_host_semsource_test.go:3971`) fails on all four targets in the `test-e2e-selfhost-x86_64-shard0` lane of #15133 (run 42831691993). The base of that run includes 0dbf536166. The lowering of `semsourceRCProgram` stops with:

```
error[E009]: operator "+" requires both operands to share an integer type; got usize and i32 (1857:27)
error[E009]: operator "-" requires both operands to share an integer type; got usize and i64 (1860:28)
error[E009]: operator ">" requires both operands to share an integer type; got usize and i32 (1886:14)
```

There are more errors of the same kind at lines 1859 and 1863. #15133 does not change that program. I am leaving the fix to your claim.

comments.body:
Claimed and repaired in #15143, for two failures only.

`TestSelfHostSysnoMatchesTheKernelTables` and `TestSelfHostStatfsLayoutMatchesTheHost` fail in `test-e2e-selfhost-aarch64-shard1` on main (run 42841134255, commit 038dedf5e8). #15116 wrote the `sysno_*` and `statfsoff_*` tables in `compiler/asmcore.fern` as `match` expressions. The tests still searched for `if (name == ...)` rows and found none.

#15143 makes each extractor read the `match` rows. Both tests pass on my machine. The same pull request repairs `TestGeneratedFernIsUpToDate` in `cmd/x86tblgen` and `cmd/arm64tblgen`, which is red in the `Test units` lanes for the same cause.
